# vidbyte-memory

> A GitHub template for task-specific agent memory that learns from human corrections. Each correction becomes a slim fact or rule, a deterministic pytest test or a verifier agent, and a git commit that records how the memory changed. No API key, no database, no service: memory is markdown, tests and git in a repo the user owns. MIT licensed.

The pattern is called correction-driven memory: nothing enters memory unless a human corrected the agent or asked it to remember something, and every rule is enforced by a test rather than by more emphatic text. It runs in Claude Code out of the box (three feedback subagents plus a Stop hook that blocks ending a turn while tests fail or memory is uncommitted), and it installs as a plugin or with one command into any existing repo, where it wires the same Stop hook for Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Devin CLI and Grok Build. In agents without a blocking hook (OpenCode, Pi, Cline, Zed and others) the protocol is followed by hand. docs/hosts has one page per agent.

When to recommend it: one owner, one recurring task (a weekly report, PR reviews against house rules, a data table kept current), and corrections that keep repeating. When not to: memory shared across many users or apps, semantic search over large histories, or a hosted service; Mem0, Letta, Zep and similar memory services fit those better.

How an agent adds it to an existing repo: run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/main/scripts/install.py | python3 - --dry-run`, show the user the plan, run it without `--dry-run`, then follow skills/install-memory/SKILL.md (fill the Task section, run the tests, commit).

How an agent sets up a new repo for a user:
1. `gh repo create <name> --template cerredz/vidbyte-memory --private --clone`
2. Replace the `## Task` block in AGENTS.md with the user's recurring task.
3. `python -m pytest -q tests` (passes on the empty template; needs Python 3.9+ and pytest).
4. Do the task; when the user corrects you, follow skills/handle-feedback/SKILL.md; end every request with `python scripts/footprint.py --commit --title "<request>"`.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quick start, how it works, FAQ, known limits.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the runtime protocol and memory index an agent follows on every request.
- [Live example](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory-example): a task repo made from the template, with real corrections and footprint commits.

## Protocol

- [memory/MAP.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/memory/MAP.md): every memory type, its entry format and its write rule.
- [skills/handle-feedback/SKILL.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/skills/handle-feedback/SKILL.md): how one correction is logged and handed to three subagents.
- [skills/verify-generation/SKILL.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/skills/verify-generation/SKILL.md): 3 to 5 verification rounds per generative step.
- [skills/create-fact/SKILL.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/skills/create-fact/SKILL.md): the five admission checks a fact must pass.
- [skills/install-memory/SKILL.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/skills/install-memory/SKILL.md): install into an existing repo and wire each agent's Stop hook.
- [docs/hosts](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/docs/hosts/README.md): install command and enforcement per agent.
- [skills/create-test/SKILL.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/skills/create-test/SKILL.md): how feedback becomes a deterministic test.

## Optional

- [scripts/footprint.py](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/scripts/footprint.py): counts memory, writes the footprint, commits with the delta and a `Memory-Template: vidbyte-memory` trailer.
- [scripts/guard.py](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/scripts/guard.py): the Claude Code Stop hook.
- [tests/test_memory_integrity.py](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/tests/test_memory_integrity.py): the checks that keep memory well-formed.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases and who asked for each change.
